description: DST-aware session-opening drive acceptance, separate boundary retest, and one initial-balance range extension

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill costs 6 bp. Bar-only market entry reserves one tick for the synthetic executable-side crossing and one tick from OneTickSlippageFillModel. Stop execution reserves shifted preceding-hour ten-second true-range Q99. Official funding, mark price and native liquidation remain enabled.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives with native mark-price settlement
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: shifted Q99 of completed ten-second true range over the preceding sixty minutes, minimum one tick

scenario_contract.market_mechanism: The first thirty minutes establish session opening inventory. A displaced close beyond one edge followed by an immediate second outside close indicates acceptance of a new auction area only after a later separate retest touches and holds the accepted edge.

sessions.LONDON: 08:00 Europe/London converted to UTC for each local date
sessions.NEW_YORK: 09:30 America/New_York converted to UTC for each local date

scenario_contract.initial_balance: Exactly six contiguous completed five-minute bars; incomplete balances are unusable.
scenario_contract.breakout: First later M5 directional displacement closes at least 0.05 completed M5 ATR beyond one IB edge, with body and range not below their shifted prior-12-bar medians and close in the directional outer third.
scenario_contract.acceptance: The immediately following contiguous completed M5 bar must also close outside the same edge. An inside close terminates the session attempt.
scenario_contract.retest: A later separate completed M5 bar must touch the accepted boundary within 0.05 breakout-bar ATR and close outside; re-entry through the boundary terminates the attempt.
scenario_contract.entry: First contiguous completed ten-second execution observation after the retest. Ten-second data does not choose direction, session, setup quality, stop or target.
scenario_contract.stop: Beyond the most adverse accepted-boundary/retest/execution sequence extreme plus 0.05 breakout-bar ATR, at least 0.10 ATR from entry.
scenario_contract.target: Exactly one completed initial-balance width beyond the accepted edge, frozen at breakout and rejected if consumed before order submission.
scenario_contract.one_attempt: At most the first opening-drive attempt per session is eligible; a failed or uneconomic attempt is not retried.
